events.symptom: Graph search reconstructs innerHTML on every input event, discarding keyboard focus and cursor continuity.
events.acceptance: Typing successive characters keeps the search field focused, preserves selection and filters matching nodes.

events.symptom: Click or Enter on a graph node replaces its DOM without restoring focus, interrupting keyboard exploration.
events.acceptance: Selecting a node by keyboard retains visible focus on the selected node after graph rerender.

events.symptom: Git status and repository evidence availability are shown as technical fragments, while node freshness and authority are not clearly distinguished in the graph hierarchy.
events.acceptance: A prominent graph scope summary accurately differentiates unverified Git, no repository claims, fresh, stale and unchecked states; inspector separates evidence authority from Git verification.

events.symptom: Graph meta text is 9.5px, origin labels 8px, and graph relationship metadata 9px, creating difficult reading at normal zoom.
events.acceptance: Graph context, node relationship labels and essential metadata use a readable type scale without obscuring the primary graph.

events.symptom: Body min-width 860px and graph min-width 560px plus inspector min-width 300px force narrow-window clipping rather than responsive transposition.
events.acceptance: At 760px and 390px viewport widths all primary graph controls, graph canvas and inspector remain accessible without horizontal viewport scrolling.

events.symptom: Raw authority classes and inferred/typed relation origins need domain-accurate explanatory labels and separation from proof claims.
events.acceptance: The graph clearly describes how canonical, advisory typed and optional similarity edges differ, and never equates agent-derived inference with verified Git provenance.
